source_theorem.coboundary_invariance: Replacing z by z+D c changes pi0(z) by an element of the projected repair image and hence leaves the obstruction class unchanged.
source_theorem.proof: F1_K2=ker(pi0). Existence of b with z+D b in F1 is exactly pi0(z)+pi0(D b)=0; the projected image is a vector space, so sign is immaterial.
source_theorem.statement: For closed z in K2, FILTRATION_LIFT_1(z) iff pi0(z) lies in im(pi0 D|K1).
